verdict.rationale: An operating system could plausibly offer background automation, so this axis applies. The only related evidence is the 'Start an application at login' guide, which is a one-time launch at login, not a recurring or autonomous automation. That makes it an adjacent feature that earns no credit. Nothing in the pack documents scheduled tasks, background agents or AI-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
